sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 72 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: This component reuses the existing pinned independent course recipe from us-inde-motorsports-ranch-8dbe7597/inde-motorsports-ranch-full without changing any source nodes or branch selections. It is included in the aggregate entry for the same venue. The existing draft branch identification, historical alignment and distance limitations remain in force; the identification URL establishes the venue and is not a claim of a current certified lap. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 72 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

refinement.note: Direct native-image reads correct the long-straight edge picks, paddock outer fold, north approach curb and closure transition. The two repeated closure controls repeat station0; intermediate positions interpolate, not independent observations. Preserved controls retain the automatic local-appearance seed and are not image measurements. Display-only3x straight strips and4x fold crop do not improve native detail or registration accuracy; reading precision is approximately metre-level, not a survey. Shared-pavement branches and aprons use inferred joins where no continuous separate physical edge exists, particularly around230-260,345-365,470-490,590-635,675-705,1000-1080 and1220-1245. Original trace, provisional direction/configuration and missing timing remain unchanged. Retained terrain is approximate; curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.

refinement.note: Seven native-image edge reads correct the compressed inner bend at stations25-35 and confirm the outer edge at33. Other paired controls preserve the automatic seed; they are not independent measurements. Coordinates are read from the pinned native mosaic using a display-only4x crop; requested pixels and roughly metre-level reading precision are not survey or registration accuracy. Shared-pavement branch openings near0-30,150-170,270-310 and350-370 retain inferred joins rather than observed continuous physical edges. Source trace, provisional branch identity/direction and timing remain unchanged. Curbs illustrative; terrain approximate and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. The source centreline was checked against this image; candidate edges must bracket its smoothed cross-sections. This opt-in constraint does not set a road width or establish positional accuracy. It is unsuitable for an unaligned source trace. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.
